name: WATCH_CURATION_SWR_20261107
comment: costs 8-11 s warm on this host; the 14:43 ET page sweep measured PENDING 24 s and 'watch-curation
aborted at 30 s' with 'Loading your watchlist…' still on screen at 25 s. The route now serves the
last good body at once and refreshes it in the background (scripts/lib/stale_serve.py, the
LQ-20261107-201 pattern). This gate pins the properties that make it safe: a warm hit never
recomputes, a stale body is served with its age and starts exactly one refresh, a failed read is
never cached (the payload-gap ValueError still reaches the page), the cache key carries the
identity so one operator's watchlist is never served to another, and a restart serves the
persisted body instead of computing cold.
Registered because a new pytest file that no gate names is not run by CI (check_test_coverage --fail-on-new).
